title: Convergence groups
description: Convergence groups on compact metric spaces, from the definition by sequences: every element is elliptic, parabolic or loxodromic, loxodromic elements have attracting and repelling fixed points and a compact fundamental domain, and the stabilizer of a loxodromic fixed point is virtually infinite cyclic.
prerequisites: core course Point-Set Topology (C90): compact metric spaces
the course proves every other fact it uses
